title: finally and rethrow

blocks.explainMd: finally is cleanup. It runs after try, whether or not a throw happened.

blocks.promptMd: > `attempt()` tries a throw, `finally` pushes `"clear"` into `notes`, then rethrows. Print `notes[0]` by catching outside (`clear`).

hintLadder.md: `finally` is the place that always records cleanup.
Push `"clear"` in `finally`. Let the throw leave `attempt`.
Catch outside `attempt` so you can print `notes[0]`.

description: Work that must run after a try, even when you throw again.
